instruction: I need higher quality video snapshots from VLC for my presentations. Could you help me change the snapshot format from PNG to TIFF for better quality?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.verification: Created custom metric function check_snapshot_format__ccaf0dcd that reads vlcrc file and verifies snapshot-format=tiff. Default is png, task requires changing to tiff for higher quality.
